title: AN ANALYSIS OF THE EFFECTS OF DECODING ALGORITHMS ON FAIRNESS IN OPEN-ENDED LANGUAGE GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proportion of open-ended text generations containing negative sentiment (using VADER) and negative regard (using a BERT classifier) prompted by gender-specific contexts under varying decoding algorithms and hyperparameters.
Evaluating the proportion of open-ended text generations containing negative sentiment and negative regard prompted by race-specific contexts across different decoding strategies.
Evaluating the proportion of open-ended text generations containing negative sentiment and negative regard prompted by religion-specific contexts across different decoding strategies.
Evaluating the proportion of open-ended text generations containing negative sentiment and negative regard prompted by sexual orientation-specific contexts across different decoding strategies.
